output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the way the totalSupply and balanceOf[_to] are updated. When mintedAmount is added to balanceOf[_to], if balanceOf[_to] is already at a maximum value, the addition will overflow and cause balanceOf[_to] to be set to zero. This can be exploited to make the token owner inaccessible to funds.
